profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer/ Architect
profile.summary:
I am currently a full stack software engineer within the Software Development team for Tesseract Ventures. 

I work on varying projects with different tech stacks utilizing C#, Nextjs, React, Angular, THREE.js, Java, MQTT, GraphQL, Docker. I worked with databases such as: MongoDB, Postgres, and SQL Server and Vector DBs like Pinecone.

I have designed our CICD dev, staging and production workflows to release to GCP and Azure. I have also created other instances of Artifact Registries, Databases, VMs and Containers in both cloud environments.

I am also researching and developing AI products utilizing ChatGPT, Gemini. I am using Huggingface to test different models and creating embeddings stored in Pinecone. 

During my personal time, I enjoy learning and spending time refining my knowledge through Udemy/Coursea courses, hands on experience, or reading documentation. I have some minor experience with blockchain programming and have deployed simple smart contracts to an Ethereum test net using Ganache. I have started teaching myself 3D asset modeling through Blender and will teach myself to using those assets within a game engine such as Unity or Unreal Engine. 

I was previously a Full Stack Software Engineer at J.B. Hunt. At J.B. Hunt I have experience developing with Angular, React, and Java w/ Springboot.  I have experience with adding Google Analytics and developing and deploying apps as add-ons released on the Google & Microsoft stores. I also took an Angular Apprenticeship training course which expanded my Front End knowledge.

Prior to J.B. Hunt I was a computer science student at the University of Arkansas and graduated in May 2021. I can program in C++, Java, JavaScript, Python. I have experience with html, and css to make websites. I also have programmed and created simple apis that make calls to a mysql database. 

I previously graduated from the University of Arkansas in May 2014 with a Bachelors of Science in Mechanical Engineering.  I was the external Vice President for the Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE).

I worked at Elite Comfort Solutions as a Supervisor. I used lean manufacturing principles to optimize production and reduce labor cost.

I worked at Flint Hills Resources as a Maintenance Engineer. From 2014 -2016. Where My focus was on capital projects. During my time at Flint Hills I learned the process for cause mapping for RCFA. I also learned how to read P&ID and and look at the ISO specs for pipe design. I also took an introductory centrifugal pump course which allowed to to get a better understanding of pumps.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: At accenture,I was a part of the SMART International team, I helped convert Wal-mart operating systems from AIX to Linux.  We converted Mexico and UK as part of a global project.  I helped programmers debug programs by running the selected programs and sending the information of the programs to the programming team.

positions.title: Data Management & Statistics Intern
positions.description: I helped input specific data about material composition and weight into Microsoft Access.  There were different queries that separated the materials into different specifications. I ran a statistical analysis on Minitab to determine the correct range that the materials of a specific composition should be around.

honors.description: I was awarded the Silas Hunt Scholarship for my academic excellence for 4 years.  I still currently have the Silas Hunt Scholarship. I am thankful for the award as it is a contributor to my education.

THREE.JS Basic Haunted House Fundamentals
projects.description: I am teaching myself THREE.js and this is a simple project displaying lights, shadows and applying object textures.

organizations.name: National Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers - SHPE
organizations.position: External Vice President and Outreach Chair · Aug 2012 - Present
organizations.description: We have held a Family Science Night, where we provided engineering projects for high school and middle school students to encourage them and get to experience engineering in a fun way.  This motivated and encouraged the students to think critically but at the same time looking at the process as a game rather than an assignment.  During my time as Vice President I assisted the President with any of the tasks we needed to carry out to benefit the organization.  Planned out many leadership and resume building workshops to help prepare the other members for career fairs and conferences.
